text:
watcherbot: PagerDuty alert -> HIGH 5xx rate on inference-gateway-prod (5m error rate 14.6%). Route: /v1/infer/stream. Auto-escalate to oncall. Link: https://pd.redwood/INC-2026-1777
michelle: Acked. I'm oncall, starting triage. Can someone grab runbook? :eyes:
sam: Seen in EU (eu-west1) primarily. Spikes started ~02:30 UTC. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/inference-gateway
watcherbot: Incident created INC-2026-1777, paging rotation engaged.
raj: Trend looks like upstream auth-proxy returning 502/503 during token introspect. I'm going to revert the auth-proxy canary in eu-west1 (suspect change rolled ~20m ago).
michelle: Do the rollback and reduce canary traffic. Commands: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/auth-proxy --to-revision=3` and `routeset update inference-gateway --weight 0.2`
jess: K/V cache warming to avoid cold misses once we stabilize. Clearing prefix cache for hot routes: `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/cache/evict?prefix=/v1/infer`
ops-bot: Customer impact summary: 32 orgs reported elevated 5xx in last 5m; top affected: org-998, org-112. Severity: medium. Notifying support to prepare comms.
raj: Rollback started at 1777777818, monitoring pod rollout.
michelle: Post-rollback metrics: error rate dropped to 2.1% over last 3m. Latency and token-introspect errors falling. Holding for 10m observation.
sam: I'll notify #support and paste a short blurb for status page.
watcherbot: Auto-close scheduled if no further spike. Incident will remain open for RCA tracking.
michelle: Marking as resolved for now — follow-up RCA assigned to eng-infra. :white_check_mark:
